column2: performs one operation and shows the

column1: #                    1 = A - B   (negative shows as 16-bit two's complement
#                    3 = show PEAK: the largest result seen in OP 0..2
#                        since reset. Hold A = B = 0 with OP = 3 to clear it.
#   While OP = 3 the peak stays put however you change A and B
#   R0  scratch: the (unused) destination of every CMP
#   R3  A          R4  B          R5  OP
#   R7  link register for JAL/JR (assumed; nothing here keeps data in R7)
#   0x1F0  peak value (kept high so it cannot overlap the code)
# ASSUMES: CMP sets flags that BEQ/BNE/... test
# follows its CMP; JAL saves the return address and JR returns to it;
# SLR is a logical shift right by one bit; MAX is a signed maximum.

column3: 0                    # R6 = 0 for the rest of the run

column1: DO_MUL:                     # result = A x B by shift-and-add

column2: UPDATE                  # yes -> result is in R1
MUL_SKIP                # bit clear -> nothing to add

column1: DO_PEAK:                    # OP 3: show (or clear) the peak

column2: PEAK_SHOW               # some value switch is up -> just show the peak

column1: UPDATE:                     # remember the biggest result so far
